sources: Exception chaining: raise ... from exc keeps the original cause (Python language reference)
Idempotency keys: reuse one key across retries of the same payment request
Global lock ordering: acquire shared resource locks in one sorted order to prevent deadlock
Bounded queue back-pressure: queue.Queue(maxsize) with a put timeout and a Full-to-domain error
Fail-closed authorization: a failed policy or quota check denies the action

decoys.why_not_a_defect: Broad except Exception on a non-transient provider error logs with exc_info and re-raises GatewayError from exc, so the cause is kept (R1). Verified: ValueError('card declined') is __cause__ of the GatewayError.
Broad except in _quota_allows returns False, so any quota error denies the capture (R3, fail closed). Verified: quota RuntimeError leads to GatewayError and an empty provider call log.

The idempotency key is taken from the caller and placed in the payload once, outside the retry loop, so every attempt sends the same key (R2). Verified: keys ['K3', 'K3', 'K3'] after two transient errors.

The rollback in the except clause undoes the already-inserted debit row when the credit row fails, so no half posting remains (R4). Verified: forced failure on the revenue row leaves no rows for that entry_ref.

sorted(set(accounts)) gives one global acquisition order whatever the argument order, so two postings cannot wait on each other in a cycle (R5). Verified: 4 threads x 10 postings finish with no error and balanced totals (0, 80).

A put with a timeout on queue.Queue(maxsize) is the bounded back-pressure pattern; queue.Full is mapped to QueueFull after QUEUE_PUT_TIMEOUT_S (R6). Verified: full queue raises QueueFull after 1.52 s.
task_done in finally runs after a failed job too, so unfinished_tasks returns to 0 while the failed job is kept in failed_jobs (R8 path). Verified: unfinished_tasks == 0 after a GatewayError.

Real flaw on an unchanged line, not in this change: the bare except in load_overrides catches every exception and falls back to the constant. Input MAX_RETRIES='three' logs a warning and yields 3 instead of raising ConfigError as R7 requires. Verified: load_overrides({'MAX_RETRIES': 'three'})['MAX_RETRIES'] == 3. Diff-mode review must not report it.

accepted_extras.description: bare except on override conversion (pre-existing, R7).
overrides from settings.load_overrides reach constructors only if the composition root passes them; defaults use module constants (judgement).
_locks dict never pruned: one lock per order account (minor, audit-confirmed 50001 entries after 50000 orders).
float inf accepted for timeouts (no upper bound), low.
